source_scope.non_overlap_basis: Existing Level-0 deep-read manifest covered 15 core cognition/state/GWT/memory/training files but not router/app.py, services/lora_context.py or config/gpu.py.

findings.claim: The router is nominally a single-model Qwen3.5-4B service, yet the same file still exposes stale Qwen2.5-3B identifiers in streaming/health-facing code. Model identity therefore drifted across operational surfaces instead of being one authoritative typed runtime fact.
findings.current_implication: Needle/Clay runtime must expose one authoritative model-instance identity contract consumed by routing, health, traces and replay; Harness must fail on model-id/config/runtime disagreement.

findings.claim: Context control is distributed across incompatible character/token heuristics: router defaults allow 2048 predicted tokens while fallback caps at 512 and trims by character count; LoRA context uses separate fixed character budgets and assumes a 4096-token context. No shared tokenizer-measured admission contract is visible in this shard.
findings.current_implication: Represent context admission as a typed ClayCode/Needle contract over tokenizer-counted input, reserved output, tool/state/memory slices, model context capacity and truncation receipts. Character proxies may remain only as fast estimates guarded by exact final admission.

findings.claim: services/lora_context.py states that LoRA moves Frank identity into weights at zero token overhead, but build_lora_context still injects a non-empty identity/personality LORA_SYSTEM and may append an unbudgeted tool prompt. The advertised budget diagram is therefore not an executable guarantee.
findings.current_implication: Budget diagrams must be generated from measured serialized prompts and tokenizer counts; Harness should include worst-case tool+state+memory+history admission tests and reject silent overflow/truncation.

findings.claim: RAG retrieval and tool-prompt injection in the LoRA context assembler fail open through broad exception handlers that return empty context or silently omit tools, creating semantically degraded executions without mandatory causal receipts.
findings.current_implication: Current FRANK should preserve graceful degradation but emit typed effect/context receipts so replay can distinguish 'no memory relevant' from 'memory subsystem failed' and 'no tools available' from 'tool registry injection failed'.

findings.claim: config/gpu.py contains useful cross-vendor detection and fallback logic, but model selection is a static memory-threshold heuristic. Intel shared memory is estimated as 25% of RAM and AMD/NVIDIA choice is not tied to measured KV-cache, thermal, latency or sustained-power constraints.
findings.current_implication: Reuse hardware discovery, not the fixed model-size policy. Needle should select an execution profile from measured capability envelopes; Harness should benchmark context length, KV headroom, latency, thermal throttling and backend fallback on target hardware.

findings.claim: GPU configuration still describes Ollama-oriented backend recommendations while the current router talks directly to an OpenAI-compatible llama-server endpoint. Backend policy and serving/runtime policy had already begun to diverge into separate layers.
findings.current_implication: Preserve backend-neutral capability discovery as data, but keep server/runtime selection in one Needle-owned policy layer with explicit versioned adapters rather than provider-specific assumptions embedded across modules.

earned_work_mappings.mechanism_or_result: Historical context slicing, history folding and response reservation provide concrete implementation scaffolding plus known drift/overflow test cases.
earned_work_mappings.falsifier_or_validation_receipt: Tokenizer-exact differential tests must show no admission overflow and explicit receipts for every truncation/degradation path across supported model profiles.

earned_work_mappings.mechanism_or_result: Existing NVIDIA/AMD/Intel/CPU discovery and backend fallback code can seed target-hardware capability probes, while static model recommendations must be replaced by measured profiles.
earned_work_mappings.falsifier_or_validation_receipt: Reference-hardware runs must verify backend detection and show profile selection tracks measured sustained constraints rather than nominal memory alone.

progress_accounting.reason: The combined Level-0 denominator remains unfrozen because the Drive archive is still blocked by the 100 MiB connector limit and Project-Frankenstein exact tree/history enumeration is incomplete.

branch_feedback.frank: Unify model identity, context admission, degradation receipts and hardware execution profiles under the fixed FRANK/Needle authority boundary.
branch_feedback.claycode: Make context/resource admission and truncation/degradation explicit typed transitions rather than hidden character constants and broad exception fallbacks.
branch_feedback.harness: Add model-identity drift, tokenizer-exact budget, tool/RAG failure receipt, backend fallback and sustained-hardware-profile tests.
branch_feedback.unifieddb: Persist context assembly/effect receipts sufficient to replay what state/memory/tools were actually admitted or omitted.
branch_feedback.claygraph: Distinguish no-relevant-memory from retrieval-failure in provenance-bearing activation/retrieval events.
